description: This file manages the registration, loading, initialization, and removal of plugins in the Mattermost web application. It handles plugin lifecycle, communicates with the server to fetch plugin data, and manipulates the DOM to load plugin scripts.

classes.name: Plugin
classes.description: Interface defining optional initialize, uninitialize, and deprecated deinitialize methods for plugins.

classes.name: WindowWithPlugins
classes.description: Extends the Window object to include plugin management properties and regeneratorRuntime.

methods.name: registerPlugin
methods.description: Registers a plugin by ID, uninitializing any existing plugin with the same ID.

methods.name: arePluginsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if plugins are enabled based on configuration and performance debugging settings.

methods.name: initializePlugins
methods.description: Fetches and loads all enabled plugins from the server.

methods.name: getPlugins
methods.description: Queries the server for all enabled plugins.

methods.name: loadPlugin
methods.description: Loads a plugin's script, initializes it, and handles plugin lifecycle.

methods.name: initializePlugin
methods.description: Creates a registry for the plugin and calls its initialize method.

methods.name: removePlugin
methods.description: Uninitializes and removes a plugin, cleaning up associated resources.

methods.name: loadPluginsIfNecessary
methods.description: Synchronizes loaded plugins with server state, loading new plugins and removing outdated ones.
